modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official main at 7d60346f (release train): carries humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#542 + #548 the Troubleshooter guardian repairs a broken link by itself on fresh installs and on boxes that never chose otherwise (James, 9 Nov 2026); `wam troubleshooter --report-only` keeps it report-only across updates, and #548 makes sure that choice is never lost (quoted GUARDIAN_ACT values read as systemd reads them, an unreadable guardian.json stays report-only, overlapping installs write the choice and host.env together). Also carries #546 (gateway grant keys, behind feature switch wizard/gateway-keys, off)

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; main 9088a25 = 3e56f66 plus #24 (Agent Service repaired through App Manager), #25 (James's one-tap repair screen restored), #26 (the guardian only undoes an update when the link was healthy before it), #29 (the guardian heals app addresses), #34 (busy is not down; a restart that didn't hold is not repeated), #35 (HEAD answers so the shell opens the real Troubleshooter), #36/#38 (owner-approved repair plans with backups and Undo), #39 (replies that never start are an incident; owner can restart Hermes while it looks green), #40 (WizardOS spelling), #41 (an approved Hermes restart actually runs; a draining restart is reported as in progress), #42 (bounded Hermes restart: the drain stops waiting and the gateway is restarted, Restart now, crash-loop handoff, reply keeper check, repair plans on by default, the page watches itself, no Telegram/console advice). The guardian repairs by default: from App Manager 9f793620 `wam troubleshooter` writes GUARDIAN_ACT=1 unless the owner chose `wam troubleshooter --report-only` (kept across updates).
